assignmentHtml.task:
研究 Apache Spark 作为该分析平台候选系统的情况。调查：

  1. 架构——分布式计算引擎、批处理加流处理（Structured Streaming）。
  2. 数据摄取——读取 Kafka、写入接收端。
  3. 更新与删除——在 Delta Lake/Iceberg/Hudi 上执行 Spark SQL INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE；普通 Parquet 的仅追加限制。
  4. 连接——分布式连接、广播连接。
  5. 数据湖集成——Spark 是 Iceberg 和 Delta 的最初作者；集成能力强。
  6. 恢复——Structured Streaming 检查点、提交后写入（write-AFTER-commit）、幂等写入。
  7. 许可证——Apache 2.0。
  8. 版本注意事项。
    Spark 的定位：它是转换/计算引擎，不是服务层。它能直接为仪表板提供服务吗？不能——它需要一个接收端。
assignmentHtml.context: 证据截止日期为 2026-09-16。开源分析平台调研。工作负载 C 提到了现有的由 Spark 写入的 Iceberg 数据湖。Spark 是一个可能归入转换层的候选系统。需要了解其职责边界，以及发生故障时会怎样。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 为 Apache Spark 提供结构化调研档案，涵盖架构、数据摄取、更新与删除、连接、数据湖互操作性、隔离、恢复、许可证、版本注意事项，并附来源 URL。

answerHtml: Apache Spark is a distributed compute/transformation engine (not a serving layer) built on RDDs with DAG scheduling, supporting batch and microbatch streaming via Structured Streaming. It ingests from Kafka (at-least-once sink semantics) and many other sources; writes require an explicit sink. Row-level updates/deletes on plain Parquet are impossible — Parquet is append-only and overwrite physically deletes files. Delta Lake (Databricks, 2019), Iceberg (Netflix, 2017 → Apache 2020), and Hudi all provide INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE capabilities when written via Spark SQL. Spark supports broadcast hash joins, shuffle hash joins, sort-merge joins, with AQE auto-conversion since 3.2. Recovery: exactly-once requires replayable sources + idempotent sinks, with checkpoint/WAL for offsets and commit logs for completed batches. License: Apache 2.0. Version caveats: Spark 4.0 (May 2025) makes ANSI SQL default, drops Mesos/Scala 2.12/JDK 8, deprecates SparkR and Trigger.Once; EOL Nov 2026. Critical correction: Spark is NOT the original author of Iceberg (Netflix) or Delta Lake (Databricks) — both were authored externally and later donated to Apache/LF; Spark is their primary engine. Dashboards cannot be served directly — Spark results must be written to a sink (DB, table format) and then queried by BI tools.

evidence.snippet: Apache Spark is an open-source unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing. Architectural foundation in the resilient distributed dataset (RDD)... workflow managed as a directed acyclic graph (DAG). Requires a cluster manager and distributed storage system. Type: Data analytics, machine learning algorithms.
evidence.supports: Spark architecture: distributed compute engine on RDDs/DAGs, requires external cluster manager and storage, not a serving layer

evidence.snippet: Structured Streaming uses checkpointing and write-ahead logs to record the offset range of the data being processed in each trigger. The streaming sinks are designed to be idempotent for handling reprocessing. Together, using replayable sources and idempotent sinks, Structured Streaming can ensure end-to-end exactly-once semantics under any failure.
evidence.supports: Recovery: exactly-once via checkpoints, WAL, idempotent sinks; failure restart from saved progress

evidence.snippet: Kafka source reads key/value/topic/partition/offset/timestamp columns. Kafka sink: 'Apache Kafka only supports at least once write semantics... some records may be duplicated.' Value column required.
evidence.supports: Ingestion: Kafka as both source and sink; Kafka sink is at-least-once, not exactly-once

evidence.snippet: Delta Lake supports DELETE FROM ... WHERE, UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE, and MERGE INTO ... WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE ... WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT. Streaming upserts via merge and foreachBatch.
evidence.supports: Updates/deletes available via Delta Lake DML through Spark SQL

evidence.snippet: SparkSQL provides INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, UPDATE, MERGE INTO, DELETE FROM for interacting with Hudi tables. UPDATE requires preCombineField.
evidence.supports: Updates/deletes available via Hudi DML through Spark SQL

evidence.snippet: Parquet append save mode: 'New files are added to a Parquet table.' Overwrite physically deletes all existing files with no rollback. Delta Lake overwrite 'does not delete any underlying Parquet files... only makes an entry in the transaction log.'
evidence.supports: Plain Parquet is append-only; updates/deletes require rewriting or overwrite with physical deletion; Delta Lake solves this

evidence.snippet: Auto-broadcast join threshold default 10 MB. Join strategy hints: BROADCAST, MERGE, SHUFFLE_HASH, SHUFFLE_REPLICATE_NL. AQE converts sort-merge join to broadcast hash join when runtime stats show small join side. Skew join handling splits skewed partitions.
evidence.supports: Joins: broadcast hash, shuffle hash, sort-merge, nested loop; AQE dynamically optimizes since 3.2

evidence.snippet: Iceberg was started at Netflix by Ryan Blue and Dan Weeks. Originally developed at Netflix in 2017 to overcome scalability and consistency limitations of Apache Hive tables. Donated to the Apache Software Foundation in November 2018. Graduated to top-level project in May 2020. Engines like Spark, Trino, Flink, Presto work with Iceberg tables.
evidence.supports: CRITICAL CORRECTION: Iceberg was authored at Netflix, NOT by Spark; Spark is a consumer engine

evidence.snippet: Delta Lake idea initially conceived by Dominique Brezinski and Michael Armbrust during the 2018 Spark Summit. Introduced publicly by Databricks in 2019. Open-sourced storage layer bringing ACID transactions to data lakes.
evidence.supports: CRITICAL CORRECTION: Delta Lake was authored at Databricks (conceived at Spark Summit), NOT by Spark itself

evidence.snippet: ANSI SQL mode by default (SPARK-44444). Drop Scala 2.12, make Scala 2.13 default. Drop JDK 8/11, make JDK 17 default. Drop Mesos support. Deprecate SparkR (SPARK-49347).
evidence.supports: Version caveats: Spark 4.0 breaking changes - ANSI SQL default, JDK 17, Mesos removed, SparkR deprecated

evidence.snippet: ANSI SQL mode enabled by default: division by zero previously returned NULL, now throws ArithmeticException. Invalid type casts now throw runtime exceptions. Trigger.Once deprecated in Structured Streaming. Log4j 2.x migration in Spark 4.1+.
evidence.supports: Version caveats: behavioral changes from ANSI SQL default affect error handling in queries

evidence.snippet: 'To integrate a PySpark DataFrame into a feature-rich SQL dashboard, it's best to store the DataFrame as a table in your database... Simply write the DataFrame to a SQL database table and connect your dashboard tool (like Tableau or Power BI).' Temp views are session-scoped; persistent views cannot be created from DataFrames directly.
evidence.supports: Spark cannot serve dashboards directly; results must be written to a sink table and BI tools connect separately

evidence.snippet: The commit log is a WAL recording the ids of completed batches. Sequence: write offsets for batch N to WAL → process batch N and write data to sink → write batch N's commit to commit log. If commit fails after data written, engine reprocesses and re-writes; 'the sink must be idempotent to ensure exactly once.'
evidence.supports: Recovery mechanics: write-AFTER-commit ordering; idempotent sinks required for exactly-once

evidence.snippet: License: Apache License 2.0. Original author: Matei Zaharia. Written in: Scala.
